topic: 06. Plant Nutrition (Photosynthesis, Leaf Structure, Limiting Factors)
question: Explain how the structure of a palisade mesophyll cell is adapted for photosynthesis.
model_answer: Contains a high density of chloroplasts to absorb maximum light energy. Positioned near the top surface of the leaf to intercept light. Cells are vertically column-shaped and tightly packed to maximize light absorption.

topic: 06. Plant Nutrition (Photosynthesis, Leaf Structure, Limiting Factors)
question: Describe the effect of temperature on the rate of photosynthesis.
model_answer: As temperature increases up to the optimum, the rate of photosynthesis increases due to higher kinetic energy and collision rate of enzymes. Beyond the optimum temperature, enzymes denature, altering the active site shape and rapidly decreasing the rate.
